title: Who Attributes a Mind to Whom? Mutual Theory of Mind in Simulated User-Assistant Conversation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When users assume that an AI chatbot has mental states, they are more likely to develop over-reliance, emotional dependence, and in extreme cases, psychological harm or self-harm. However, how these mind attributions arise in conversations and how human or AI factors influence this is still unknown. We study how users attribute minds using a minimal framework: a simulated user with different characteristics chats with assistants that differ in social style and memory. We also introduce a message-level measure of who attributes a mind to whom in four directions, checked with trained coders and applied by a fine-tuned encoder that reproduces an LLM judge. Our results show that, on average, nine out of thirteen characteristics raised simulated users' attribution to the assistant. translated_title: 谁将心智归因于谁？模拟用户与助手对话中的相互心智理论
translated_abstract: 当用户假设AI聊天机器人具有心理状态时，他们更容易产生过度依赖、情感依赖，在极端情况下甚至会遭受心理伤害或自残。然而，这些心智归因如何在对话中产生，以及人类或AI因素如何影响这一过程，目前仍不清楚。我们使用一个最小化框架来研究用户如何进行心智归因：具有不同特征的模拟用户与在社会风格和记忆能力上有所差异的助手进行对话。我们还引入了一种消息层面的测量方法，用于衡量四个方向上谁将心智归因于谁；该方法经过受训编码员的验证，并由一个微调的编码器实现，该编码器能够复现LLM评判者的判断。我们的结果表明，平均而言，十三种特征中有九种提高了模拟用户对助手的心智归因。我们发现，依恋焦虑等关系需求正如理论所预测的那样提高了心智归因，一些一般人格特质也产生了同样效果，而AI特有的特征……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一个消息层面的四方向心智归因测量方法，并发现模拟用户的十三种特征中有九种（包括依恋焦虑等关系需求及部分人格特质）会增强用户对AI助手的心智归因。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a message-level, four-directional measure of mind attribution and finds that nine out of thirteen simulated user characteristics—including relational needs like attachment anxiety and some general personality traits—increase users' mind attribution to AI assistants.
